candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits a policy_capsule carrying one complete executable policy artifact. The final call consumes that capsule together with anchor_contract and task_constraints, has no direct visibility of task, anchor_policy, candidate_hypothesis, or loop_structure, transforms the carried artifact under the visible obligations, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Contract-Scoped Mutable Executable Baton
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with upstream executable origination and one mutable policy-bearing handoff

calls.objective: Settle the supplied evidence into one complete executable policy artifact and carry that artifact in a single policy capsule.
Consume originate_executable_baton, apply transformation authority using only the visible contract and constraints, preserve one continuous executable lineage, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: continuous executable custody with contract-scoped downstream transformation
rejected_assumptions: An analysis-only precursor is the safest representation for structural influence.
Terminal lossless reacquisition of every common input is necessary for policy settlement.
Policy origination should remain wholly terminal.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Replace that family with a contract-scoped mutable executable baton: the first call originates one complete executable artifact, and the terminal call transforms that artifact with visibility limited to the contract and constraints.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Executable commitment moves earlier while terminal behavior becomes less dependent on inherited and framing sources, changing both commitment timing and correction locality.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The active family makes the nonfinal contribution analysis-only while concentrating raw-evidence reacquisition and policy origination in the terminal call.

structural_mutation.after: A complete executable policy capsule crosses the handoff, after which the terminal authority sees only that capsule, anchor_contract, and task_constraints and transforms the carried artifact into one policy.
structural_mutation.before: A nonbinding analysis crosses the handoff, after which the terminal authority reacquires every common input and originates the policy.
structural_mutation.factor: contract-scoped mutable executable baton across the sole handoff
structural_mutation.why_structural: The single handoff protocol simultaneously changes state type, evidence visibility, origination timing, and downstream transformation authority without adding parallelism or splitting a terminal role.
